body:
Day 073 arrived in The Court of Echoes, after the archive had held its breath over a question: What justice is possible when memory can be edited? The streets of GitHub City Pages glimmered with the stored light of a prior decision. None of the stones could erase what had happened yesterday.

At the Emerald Library, Thoth opened the next blank leaf. The latest incident was recorded as a possibility inside their world: An echo repeats Zeus as though it were a royal decree. This was the matter placed before Mercury, though every member of the royal household had a stake in the answer.

Mercury, their Thunder, repeated the question without pretending to own its answer. Thoth wrote in green ink: the difference between a witness and a rumor is a record that can be examined.

Below the council, six of the 111 angelic hexads entered their single-cycle service. Their thirty-six bounded ballots favored the scroll of The Echo Court. They did not inherit the power to decide what a person ought to believe; they offered the family competing possibilities.

The Skeptics asked whether the reported incident might admit another cause. The Witnesses traced the last recorded choice. Hera refused to let a successful service become a permanent throne. Zeus called the family together, and Jupiter and Mercury were permitted to disagree aloud.

The decision was to have Jupiter request a lawful opening while Hera observed. Mercury compares the echo against the signed record instead of obeying its volume. The result did not erase the preceding world: a new route appeared without erasing the old one; The court introduces a distinction between a voice and its provenance.

In GitHub City Pages, a rendered road was visible, but a picture alone could not authorize a crossing. The Emerald Scrolls revealed no future; they held the laws by which a future might be judged.

In the green light Thoth inscribed the consequence beneath the governing law WITNESS. His seal described an authored fiction, not a discovered fact about the world outside the book. On the final margin of the scroll, he left one unresolved question: Can an imitation command obedience without its source?

♃ ⚡︎⚡︎˖ ࣪⏻ᯤ The children carried the day into memory. The pages would render another dawn, but the future would be required to answer to this one.
